title: What Is ICC?
hook: Learn the story before you learn the trigger.

launchpad.outcome: Explain ICC as Indication → Correction → Continuation, and why it isn’t the 1M entry model yet.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What story is price telling me?

slides.question: But how does price actually move through the story?
lines: You know how to read the market.
Now I’m going to show you how I organize the story price is telling me.

slides.title: What do you notice?
slides.intro: No labels yet. Just watch what price does.
slides.replayText: Same move. This time I’ll name each chapter.

end.text: Push. Pullback. Push. Now it has names.
end.card: LEARN THE STORY BEFORE YOU LEARN THE TRIGGER.

slides.heading: I · C · C

beats.title: Correction
beats.line: Price temporarily moves against that move.

beats.title: Continuation
beats.line: Price shows evidence the move is trying to resume.

slides.punch: A way to organize the story. On any timeframe.

slides.title: ICC ≠ automatically a Dayli ICC entry.

ask.prompt: A clean I-C-C just printed on the 4H. Is that a Dayli ICC entry?

options.label: Yes, ICC is ICC
options.feedback: The framework reads the story. The entry model has its own rules, and you haven’t learned them yet.

options.label: No. The framework reads the story. The 1M model has specific execution rules.

slides.title: Watch the chapters unfold
slides.intro: Play it. Step it candle by candle. Hide the labels and see if you can still read it.

pauses.text: Price pushed beyond the meaningful high. That’s new information. Indication.
Now price moved back. The tracker says correction. Continuation? Not confirmed.

end.text: Only now, after price pushed beyond again, does the last C turn solid.
end.card: ICC IS HOW DAYLI ORGANIZES THE STORY PRICE IS TELLING HER.

slides.quote: ICC is how I organize the story price is telling me. Learn the story first. The trigger comes next.

slides.prompt: In your own words: what are the three chapters of ICC?
slides.modelAnswer: Indication: price gives meaningful directional information. Correction: it moves back against that move. Continuation: it shows evidence the move is trying to resume.

takeaways: It organizes the story on any timeframe.
The 1M entry model is next, with its own rules.
remember: Learn the story before you learn the trigger.
